name: unauthorized
description: RECORDED 2026-10-23 against POST https://api.clawifi.dev/fetch with no API key and `X-Clawifi-Include-Credits: 1` (no key was used or created). /search/free, /scrape and /map answered the same 401 envelope (request_id differs). Clawifi adds `credits_charged: 0` to error bodies too; the engine zero-bills every non-2xx anyway, so consolidate never runs on it.

error.suggested_action: Provide a valid Clawifi API key and retry.
